name: doc_combine
description: Combine PDFs, in order, into one (bookmarks are kept under one entry per file). pages optionally chooses each file's pages, in step with paths: a range such as "1-3, 6" or null for all pages.

open.description: Also open the result as a new document (default: only when out is omitted).

out.description: File to write. Omit to open the result as a new unsaved document instead.
